blocks.text: The name "The Redeemed Christian Church of God" was not chosen by a committee - it was given directly to the founder, the late Reverend Josiah Olufemi Akindayomi, through a revelation from God. That alone marks this church as a unique work of the Most High.

Alongside the name, God made several promises concerning this church: that He Himself would meet the church on His return; that this church would become a model to the whole world; and that other churches from every nation would come to learn and worship here.

These are large promises, but God is more than able to fulfil what He has spoken - {{nm 23:19|Numbers 23:19}}. Even today, that faithfulness shows: workers who apply to other missions for employment are often engaged without a formal interview, purely on the strength of the church's reputation, and missions with their own Bible colleges still send ministers to be trained in ours.

By God's grace, the church continues to grow rapidly - and we believe it will keep growing. It's for these reasons that the qualifications and code of conduct expected of every worker have been put down in writing: so that everyone involved knows exactly what's expected of them.
